# TheoryDrivenNeuromorphicDesign

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A paradigm shift from experiment-first to theory-first design, using mathematical laws to predict and optimize neuromorphic hardware behavior before physical implementation. Reduces reliance on costly experimental iterations, accelerating the development of scalable TCC/iNEST architectures with predictable intelligence characteristics.
